security_audit.summary: The external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code block markers and illustrative shell examples. The high entropy warning is also a false positive; SKILL.md is readable Korean and English documentation with Unicode diagrams. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, network access, or bundled executable payloads were found.

remediation.issue: Broad Bash permission in an instructional skill
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed-tools if the skill only provides writing guidance. Keep Bash only when packaging commands are required.

content.value_statement: Skill authors need clear structure before they publish reusable agent workflows. This skill gives a practical creation process for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code skill packages.
actual_capabilities: Explains required SKILL.md frontmatter and body structure.
Shows progressive disclosure patterns for references and bundled resources.
Guides example analysis, initialization, editing, packaging, and iteration.
Lists files and documents that should not be included in agent-facing skills.
Provides a validation checklist for descriptions, file depth, and unnecessary files.
limitations: Does not include the referenced init_skill.py or package_skill.py scripts.
Focuses on Claude skills, so other agents may need platform-specific adjustments.
Uses Korean and English text, so some teams may need localization.
Does not provide automated validation or test execution.

use_cases.title: Build a New Agent Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated workflow into a structured skill with clear triggers, body guidance, and optional resources.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Skill Packages
use_cases.description: Use one creation checklist for metadata, progressive disclosure, bundled resources, and excluded files.

use_cases.title: Prepare Skills for Marketplace Review
use_cases.description: Check that the package is concise, agent-facing, and aligned with expected skill structure.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new skill for my repeated workflow. Ask for examples, then draft the skill structure and required metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SKILL.md and improve its description, quick start, workflow, examples, and validation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Bundled Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these workflow examples and decide which scripts, references, or assets should be bundled with the skill.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Skill Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this skill package for progressive disclosure, unnecessary files, risky tool use, and marketplace readiness.

output_examples.input: I need a skill for PDF document processing.
output_examples.output: The assistant defines the skill purpose, use triggers, core workflow, reference needs, bundled resources, and validation checklist.

output_examples.input: Review my existing skill before publishing.
output: The assistant identifies missing metadata and unclear trigger language.
It recommends shorter body guidance and moves deep details into references.
It flags unnecessary user-facing documents for removal.

output_examples.input: Plan resources for a BigQuery analysis skill.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes domain references for finance, sales, and product use while keeping SKILL.md concise.

best_practices: Start from concrete user examples before drafting the skill body.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed domain material into references.
Validate required metadata, trigger language, resource depth, and unnecessary files before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not include README, changelog, or installation documents meant for humans.
Do not place large reference material directly in SKILL.md.
Do not declare broad tool access unless the workflow truly needs it.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create structured Claude skill packages with metadata, workflow guidance, examples, and optional bundled resources.

faq.question: Can Codex or Claude Code users apply it?
faq.answer: Yes. The structure is useful, but users may need to adapt details for each agent platform.

faq.question: Does it generate scripts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It explains when scripts may help, but it does not include script generation tools.

faq.question: What should a skill description include?
faq.answer: It should state what the skill does and when an agent should use it.

faq.question: How does progressive disclosure help?
faq.answer: It keeps common guidance in SKILL.md and moves detailed material into resources loaded only when needed.

faq.question: Is this skill ready for every marketplace?
faq.answer: No. Review marketplace rules, supported tools, and security expectations before publishing.
